CustomField.formula:
IF( YEAR(Customer_Requested_Date__c)<YEAR(Requested_Ship_Date_Change__c), "Next year", IF( CEILING( MONTH ( Customer_Requested_Date__c ) / 3 )=CEILING( MONTH ( Requested_Ship_Date_Change__c ) / 3 )-1, "Next Quarter",
IF(CEILING( MONTH ( Customer_Requested_Date__c ) / 3 )=CEILING( MONTH ( Requested_Ship_Date_Change__c ) / 3 )-2 ,"In 2 Quarters",
IF( CEILING( MONTH ( Customer_Requested_Date__c ) / 3 )=CEILING( MONTH ( Requested_Ship_Date_Change__c ) / 3 )-3, "In 3 Quarters",
IF(ADDMONTHS(Customer_Requested_Date__c,1)<=Requested_Ship_Date_Change__c, "Next Month", "Current")))))
CustomField.label: TimeDifference
